name: The Kolkar of Desolace
summary: The Kolkar threaten Horde lands from their stronghold in Desolace. Regthar Deathgate sends Horde champions west across the mountains to reinforce scout Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post.

sections.title: A Threat Across the Mountains
sections.body: Centaur raiders keep pressing into the Barrens, and Regthar Deathgate knows that fighting them there will not end the threat. The Kolkar clan draws its strength from the rugged lands on Kalimdor's western coast. While their ancestral stronghold remains beyond Horde control, raiders will keep pouring through the mountain passes. To stop them, the Horde must strike at their home.

sections.title: Ghost Walker Post
sections.body: Ghost Walker Post gives the Horde a foothold deep in Desolace. Scout Felgur Twocuts watches the rival centaur clans from the outpost. Regthar sends seasoned fighters from the Barrens to serve under Felgur, carrying the Horde's campaign west from defense to direct action.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate, an orc warrior at the bunker west of the Crossroads in the Barrens, directs you to carry the fight into the Kolkar's ancestral lands.

faq.q: Where is Ghost Walker Post located?
faq.answer: Ghost Walker Post is an isolated Horde camp along the rugged paths of Desolace, west of the Kalimdor mountain ridge.

faq.q: Why is the Horde focusing on Desolace?
faq.answer: The Kolkar who raid the Barrens come from the larger centaur clans rooted in Desolace. Regthar knows defense alone cannot stop the invasions while the Kolkar stronghold remains intact.
Felgur Twocuts is a Horde scout at Ghost Walker Post. He watches the rival centaur clans in Desolace and organizes strikes against them.
No. You carry a message from the Barrens into Desolace, where harder challenges await Horde adventurers.

faq.q: Which centaur clan does this quest target?
faq.answer: The Kolkar clan is the target. Its centaur raiders come from Desolace and have pushed into the Barrens and Durotar.

angles.text: For the Horde, this marks a shift from guarding young settlements in Durotar and the Barrens to taking the fight into hostile lands.
As a tauren, you know centaur aggression brought your nomadic tribes close to extinction before your alliance with Thrall. Fighting them in their Desolace homelands carries a personal cost.
As an orc, you have secured a foothold in eastern Kalimdor. The untamed centaur clans still threaten Horde supply lines.
